skill_name: You are provided with a survey. Summarize the results of the survey in 100 words.
workflow: The survey revealed that the majority of participants (47%) viewed climate change as the most pressing environmental issue. This was closely followed by pollution (25%) and biodiversity loss (18%). Unsustainable use of natural resources was least mentioned, with only 10% of participants identifying it as the major environmental concern. These results demonstrate the importance of raising awareness of the various environmental issues and the need to take action to address them.
